title: Psychology · Paper 1 — original core sample
subject: psychology
instructions: Answer all three short-response questions and then answer one of the three alternatives within Question 4. Type every response beside its question; no separate answer sheet is used.

questions.label: Question 1 — biological approach
questions.prompt: Explain one study of how one neurotransmitter may influence human behaviour.

questions.label: Question 2 — cognitive approach
questions.prompt: Explain one study related to schema theory and memory.

questions.label: Question 3 — sociocultural approach
questions.prompt: Explain one study of how belonging to a group may influence an individual’s behaviour.

questions.label: Question 4 — choose one extended response
questions.prompt:
Choose one alternative and state its letter at the start of your response.
A. Evaluate one or more research methods used to study the relationship between the brain and behaviour.
B. Discuss one or more explanations of reconstructive memory.
C. Discuss the influence of one cultural dimension on behaviour.
